title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE SALT INDUSTRY COOPERATIVES ACT
full_text:
ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE SALT INDUSTRY COOPERATIVES ACT

Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Salt Industry Cooperatives Act and matters necessary for the enforcement thereof.

Article 2 (Authorization to Establish a Cooperative, etc.)
(1) A person intending to establish a salt industry cooperative (hereinafter referred to as a "cooperative") under Article 6 (1) of the Salt Industry Cooperatives Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") shall submit an application for authorization to establish the cooperative to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, accompanied by the following documents: <Amended on March 18, 2009; March 23, 2013>
1. A list of promoters;
2. A copy of the minutes of the promoters' meeting concerning establishment of the cooperative;
3. Articles of association;
4. A list of members.
(2) Where a cooperative seeks authorization for an amendment to its articles of association under Article 7 (3) of the Act, it shall submit an application for such authorization to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries within seven days after a resolution of the general meeting, accompanied by a copy of the minutes of that meeting. <Amended on March 18, 2009; March 23, 2013>

Article 3 (Qualifications of Full-Time Directors of Cooperatives) The term "person meeting the requirements prescribed by Presidential Decree" in the proviso of Article 20 (4) of the Act means a person falling under any of the following:
1. A person with at least 10 years of experience working full-time for a cooperative;
2. A person with at least 10 years of experience working full-time for a State agency, local government, or public institution under the Act on the Management of Public Institutions in a field related to the salt industry;
3. A person with experience working at a research institution, educational institution, or enterprise related to the salt industry who is recognized under the articles of association of the cooperative as having qualifications equivalent to or higher than those of a person specified in subparagraph 1 or 2.

Article 4 (Procedures for Approval of Mutual Aid Business Regulations) Where a cooperative seeks approval of its mutual aid business regulations pursuant to Article 33 (1) of the Act, it shall submit an application for approval of the mutual aid business regulations to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, accompanied by the relevant regulations. <Amended on March 18, 2009; March 23, 2013>

Article 5 (Reporting Dissolution) Where a cooperative intends to report its dissolution under Article 48 (2) of the Act, it shall submit a report of dissolution to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, accompanied by a statement of reasons for dissolution and supporting documents. <Amended on March 18, 2009; March 23, 2013>

Article 6 (Reporting) Where the chairperson of a cooperative reports to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries pursuant to Article 53 (1) of the Act, the chairperson shall submit the report with evidentiary or reference documents related to the matters reported. <Amended on March 18, 2009; March 23, 2013>

Article 6-2 Deleted. <March 3, 2020>

Article 7 (Imposition of Administrative Fines) The standards for imposing administrative fines under Article 60 (1) and (2) of the Act shall be as specified in the attached Table: Provided, That the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may increase an administrative fine by up to twice the relevant amount or reduce it by up to one half of the amount, taking into account the motive for and frequency of the violation. <Amended on March 18, 2009; March 23, 2013>

ADDENDA <No. 20868, June 25, 2008>

This Decree shall enter into force on June 28, 2008.

ADDENDA <No. 21353, March 18, 2009>

This Decree shall enter into force on March 20, 2009.

ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 24455, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) through (60) Omitted.

(61) The Enforcement Decree of the Salt Industry Cooperatives Act is partially amended as follows:

In the part of Article 2 (1) other than its subparagraphs, Article 2 (2), Articles 4 through 6, and the proviso of Article 7, "Minister for Food, Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries" shall be replaced with "Minister of Oceans and Fisheries", respectively.

(62) through (76) Omitted.

ADDENDA <No. 25840, December 9, 2014> (Partial Amendment of the Enforcement Decree of the Building Act and Other Decrees to Reform Regulations, Including Establishing Deadlines for Regulatory Review)

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on January 1, 2015.

Articles 2 through 16 Omitted.

ADDENDA <No. 27751, December 30, 2016> (Partial Amendment of the Enforcement Decree of the Fair Transactions in Franchise Business Act and Other Decrees to Establish Deadlines for Regulatory Review, etc.)

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on January 1, 2017. <Proviso omitted>

Articles 2 through 12 Omitted.

ADDENDA <No. 30509, March 3, 2020> (Presidential Decree Partially Amending 144 Presidential Decrees to Abolish Deadlines for Regulatory Review, etc.)

This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
